summary.text: Brian Feldman is a Democratic member of the Maryland State Senate from District 15 who has served since September 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and certified public accountant, he chairs the Committee on Education, Energy, and the Environment and previously served in the House of Delegates from 2003 to 2013.

paragraphs.text: Feldman was born in Pittsburgh on February 4, 1961, and earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from Pennsylvania State University in 1983, a law degree from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law in 1986, and a master's degree in government from The Johns Hopkins University in 2000.
He worked as an attorney and certified public accountant at Price Waterhouse and then as a trial attorney in the U.S. Department of Justice Tax Division from 1988 to 2001.
He has been an adjunct professor at Johns Hopkins since 2006, has been of counsel at Kozusko, Harris, Vetter, Wareh LLP since 2011, and has also taught at the University of Maryland since 2019.

Feldman served in the House of Delegates from 2003 to 2013, where he sat on the Economic Matters Committee, was House Parliamentarian from 2011 to 2013, and chaired the Montgomery County House Delegation.
He has been a member of the Senate since September 17, 2013.

He was vice chair of the Finance Committee from 2019 to 2023 and since 2023 has chaired the Committee on Education, Energy, and the Environment; he also serves on the Rules, Executive Nominations and Legislative Policy committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
